index_rule: pointers/oids/metadata only; no blob bytes in index; incremental per-ref checkpoints
project_posture: working name provisional; all decisions revisable

sibling.index_merge: never — planes separate; cross-plane bridge only via explicit (path, sha256) record, gated, not in v0

signal_rule: evidence/oracle only, never content; bytes come only from git objects, oid-verified

subjects.role: subject (git history only; session store stays on sibling plane)
